idea-plugin.name: Ktorfit & Retrofit Studio
idea-plugin.description:
Ktorfit & Retrofit Studio is a professional tool for visualizing, inspecting, and generating code for your Android and Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) network layer. It provides an interactive visual "Design Mode" similar to the Jetpack Navigation Editor, tailored for both Ktorfit and Retrofit APIs.

🚀 Key Features

  • Custom Code Generation & Edge Actions: Connect two API nodes in the visual graph to trigger customizable code templates and annotations. Configure templates and rules in Settings > Tools > Edge Actions.
  • Interactive Node Graph: Visualize your service-to-endpoint relationships with a draggable and zoomable canvas.
  • Dual View Modes: Toggle between a high-level visual graph and a detailed, searchable card list.
  • Deep Inspection: Automatically extracts annotations, method signatures, return types, and parameters.
  • Powerful Filters: Live search by path or method name, and filter by HTTP method or module scope.
  • Design Tools: Includes a floating design toolbar with a hand-pan tool, zoom controls, and fit-to-screen functionality.

🛠️ Built for Modern Android

  • Full support for Kotlin K2 mode.
  • Robust discovery in complex multi-module Gradle projects.
  • Themed UI that respects Darcula and Light modes.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.2.0

  • Custom Code Generation & Edge Actions: Connect any two API nodes in the visual graph to trigger customizable code generation and annotations.
  • Edge Actions Settings UI: Dedicated configuration panel under Settings > Tools > Edge Actions to manage and customize action templates and placement rules.
  • Built-in Response Viewer: Inspect API responses directly inside the IDE with automatic syntax highlighting and format detection (JSON, XML, HTML, Plain Text).
  • Figma-Style Canvas Gestures: Smooth touchpad gestures, trackpad pinch-to-zoom, and fluid canvas panning in Graph mode.
  • Enhanced Card List View: Redesigned list layout with function headers, HTTP method badges, API paths, and quick actions matching visual graph nodes.
  • Fast Background Scanning: Background endpoint scanning and smart caching ensure instant navigation without UI freezing.

1.1.9

  • Android Studio Compatibility: Dedicated support and optimization for Android Studio.
  • Kotlin 2.0 & K2 Mode: Full compatibility with Kotlin 2.0 and K2 mode in Android Studio.
  • UI Improvements: Resolved issues with node connection linking and vertical list display.

1.1.8

  • Split Editor (Design View): Side-by-side view for Retrofit interfaces and visual API cards directly in the editor.
  • Gutter Icon Navigation: Jump directly from code declarations to visual Design view using editor gutter icons.
  • IDE Status Bar Progress: Real-time scanning progress integrated into the IDE status bar with cancellation support.
  • Instant UI Performance: Optimized endpoint expansion and card navigation to eliminate UI freezes.
